message.reasoning:
The user asks: "What is the earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" They want earliest reference from historical record. We need to provide answer. According to historians, earliest references include Josephus (Antiquities 18.3), Tacitus (Annals 15.44), Pliny the Younger (Letter 10.96). Also maybe the Gospel of Mark is earliest Christian text. But question: earliest reference from historical record. So we should mention Josephus's Antiquities of the Jews Book 18, Chapter 3, as earliest mention. Provide details: "the earliest reference is found in Josephus' Antiquities of the Jews, written around AD 93-94." Also mention that some scholars debate authenticity of the passage. Also mention other references like Tacitus and Pliny. Provide citations.

We can also use the function get_earliest_reference with name "Jesus Christ" and source "historical records". Let's do that.
